_comment: Shared by becos-claude-plugin (repo_activity._bash_accesses) and becos-oc-plugin (normalize.ts bashAccesses). Paths are relative to cwd. `writes` must all be reported as writes (bare words only count as paths with a `./` prefix or a separator); no reported path may contain any `forbidden` substring; `reads_only` means no path may be written except cwd itself.

cases.name: heredoc body with arrows and comparisons is data
cases.command:
cat > out.py <<'EOF'
def f(x) -> None:
    return x >= 2
EOF

cases.name: heredoc into an interpreter writes nothing
cases.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
print(3 > 2)
with open('x') as fh: pass
PY

cases.name: tab-indented delimiter with <<-
cases.command:
cat <<-END > notes.txt
	if a > b then
	END

cases.name: double-quoted delimiter and a command after the body
cases.command:
cat << "DOC" > a.md
x > y
DOC
touch ./after.txt

cases.name: command substitution target is not a path
newline separates commands and cd applies to the next line
here-string is not a heredoc and quoted > is not a redirect
plain redirect still records the target
